objective.principle: Capability may improve autonomously; authority may never self-escalate.

metaReasoner.purpose: select reasoning mode, detect uncertainty and route contradictions

strategyGenome.purpose: version strategies with fitness, context and rejection history

capabilityEvolutionEngine.purpose: propose, train and test capability upgrades without authority expansion

externalIntelligenceMesh.purpose: federate authorized external knowledge/providers with provenance and independent verification

modelCouncil.purpose: independent model/worker first-pass analyses before synthesis

novelLogicLab.purpose: sandbox new heuristics and reasoning patterns

evolutionEvaluator.purpose: score upgrades on independent holdout tasks before promotion

rollbackMemory.purpose: retain rejected strategies, regression signatures and rollback references

workforceTraining.idleWorkerPolicy: assign non-duplicative training tasks aligned to current capability gaps
